# One rendered file per line: role, template, output name, then the case's own settings as JSON.
# Settings not given come from the role's defaults and vars, then values.yml.
k8s_certs issuers.yaml.j2 certs-issuers.yaml {}
k8s_certs smoke.yaml.j2 certs-smoke.yaml {}
k8s_gateway gateway.yaml.j2 gateway-http.yaml {"k8s_gateway_https":false}
k8s_gateway gateway.yaml.j2 gateway-https.yaml {"k8s_gateway_https":true}
k8s_gateway smoke.yaml.j2 gateway-smoke.yaml {}
k8s_gitops source-argocd.yaml.j2 gitops-source-argocd.yaml {"k8s_gitops_engine":"argocd"}
k8s_gitops source-flux.yaml.j2 gitops-source-flux.yaml {"k8s_gitops_engine":"flux"}
k8s_gitops argocd-ui-route.yaml.j2 gitops-ui-route.yaml {"k8s_gitops_engine":"argocd"}
k8s_gitops argocd-ui-route.yaml.j2 gitops-ui-route-no-redirect.yaml {"k8s_gitops_engine":"argocd","k8s_gitops_ui_https_redirect":false}
k8s_secrets store.yaml.j2 secrets-store.yaml {}
k8s_app_route route.yaml.j2 app-route.yaml {"k8s_app_route_name":"grafana","k8s_app_route_namespace":"monitoring","k8s_app_route_service":"kube-prometheus-stack-grafana","k8s_app_route_port":80,"k8s_app_route_zone":"example.com"}
